title: Antiretroviral therapy and tuberculosis incidence
text: Antiretroviral therapy is strongly associated with a reduction in the incidence of tuberculosis in all baseline CD4 count categories. CONCLUSIONS Antiretroviral therapy is strongly associated with a reduction in the incidence of tuberculosis across all CD4 count strata.

title: Microstructural development of human newborn cerebral white matter
text: Alterations of the architecture of cerebral white matter in the developing human brain can affect cortical development and result in functional disabilities.

title: Do RAG Systems Really Suffer From Positional Bias?
text: Retrieval augmented generation can insert distracting passages. Some real retrieval pipelines have marginal positional effects according to the paper's evaluated cases.
